outcome: Proportion of deliveries at county hospitals
cohort: 28,314 deliveries covered by the New Cooperative Medical Scheme (NCMS) in Xi County, Henan Province, China, from 2009-2010 (before CPR) and 2014-2015 (after CPR)
finding: The implementation of CPR in Xi County was associated with an increase in cesarean section rates, length of stay, total medical costs, and the proportion of deliveries at county hospitals.
mod_finding: The total medical cost for both Cesarean section and vaginal delivery was significantly influenced by the CPR.
